_about: GENERATED from docs/world-designer/city.md by scripts/city-build.mjs (npm run city-data). Do not edit: change city.md and run it again. npm run check fails if the two disagree. Stats per row: money, energy, fullness, grades, social. showoff: the dearest row of the place (bought once). friends: better with friends here (alone, social is half, rounded down). need: licence | car | yard | lessons. slots: the row only runs in these day slots. grants: what the row gives (data/campusville/city_places.json).

places.name: Mall
places.feel: Cold air, bright tiles, clothes, a food court, and a cinema that still smells of popcorn.

rows.name: Walk the windows
rows.result: A full lap, three opinions about a jacket, and the bag stays empty.

rows.name: Eat at the food court
rows.result: A kota and a juice, eaten at a high table, tray taken back without being asked.

rows.name: Share a fitting room
rows.result: The curtain sticks, the verdict is honest, and that is why you brought them.

rows.name: Cheap seats
rows.result: One packet of sweets between you, and both of you pretend you followed the plot.

rows.name: Get measured
rows.result: The tailor writes your numbers on a card you will still have at exams.

rows.name: Lap the mall
rows.result: Three loops and the guard on the door starts greeting you by course.

rows.name: Work the mall floor
rows.result: You fold the same pile four times and the supervisor calls you quick, which is high praise.

rows.name: Hand out samples
rows.result: The sample cups run out in the same minute as your smile, and the pay is already counted.

rows.name: Buy the window outfit
rows.result: The bag is wider than your res cupboard and the walk to the rank feels like a runway.

rows.name: Catch the odd film
rows.result: Screen six is half empty, and you leave quoting a line nobody in the food court saw.

places.name: Bank
places.feel: Carpet, a ticket machine, and a queue with nowhere else to be. Quiet enough to hear the pens.

rows.name: Check the balance
rows.result: The screen shows the number you expected, and you stand a little taller on the way out.

rows.name: Buy a data voucher
rows.result: You Woza the pin across the glass and the teller slides it back under the slot.

rows.name: Queue with a friend
rows.result: Two tickets, one wait, and a serious ranking of the carpet tiles.

rows.name: Help a friend open a student account
rows.result: The form is long and you find the one box they kept skipping.

rows.name: Ask about a notice account
rows.result: The teller draws it on a scrap with a pen, and the lock-up finally makes sense.

rows.name: Stay for the money talk
rows.result: Twenty minutes on fees and you leave having cancelled something you did not need.

rows.name: Hand out student forms
rows.result: A clipboard by the door, and three first-years actually stop.

rows.name: Rent a small safe box for the year
rows.result: A key on a tiny ring. For a week you feel like you have a vault.

rows.name: Watch the note counter
rows.result: The machine flicks a stack so fast the whole queue goes quiet to listen.

rows.name: Get a letter stamped
rows.result: The stamp lands so firmly the desk shivers, and your letter looks official at last.

places.name: Clinic
places.feel: Mopped floors, kind voices, and a city clinic that already knows a student cough.

rows.name: Take a number
rows.result: The number is far off and the chair is plastic, and you stay until it comes.

rows.name: Collect a script
rows.result: The hatch opens, your name is right, and the packet is smaller than the wait.

rows.name: Wait with a friend
rows.result: You trade a charger and skip the performance of being brave about a cough.

rows.name: Sit with a classmate until they are called
rows.result: You walk them to the door. The nod on the way in is the whole thank-you.

rows.name: Take the first-aid class
rows.result: A bandage on a dummy, and the nurse says the tension is finally right.

rows.name: Ask about sleep
rows.result: Three plain rules on a card, and the night ahead looks simpler.

rows.name: Cover reception
rows.result: You call names in a steady voice and the file pile actually shrinks.

rows.name: Book the full screening
rows.result: They walk you through every number, including the blood pressure you can now say out loud.

rows.name: Watch the waiting-room fish
rows.result: One orange fish does your same lap, and it helps more than the pamphlet.

rows.name: Take the student pack
rows.result: Plasters, a card and a folded sheet of advice, handed over like a kit for the term.

places.name: City library
places.feel: The city library, not the one on campus. High windows, a returns chute, and a silence people keep.

rows.name: Read a chapter by the window
rows.result: Four pages in, the street drops away and the chapter starts to behave.

rows.name: Copy four pages
rows.result: The copier jams, you clear it, and the pages come out warm.

rows.name: Take the group table
rows.result: The whisper rule lasts six minutes. The work still gets done.

rows.name: Share peanuts on the steps
rows.result: The packet dies on the stone steps while you rank the setwork by weight.

rows.name: Put your phone in the basket
rows.result: The exam block is quiet enough to hear the clock, and the notes finally stick.

rows.name: Ask the question you have been avoiding
rows.result: The librarian walks you to the shelf you passed twice and makes nothing of it.

rows.name: Work the desk
rows.result: You stamp returns until your wrist complains, and a first-year thanks you like you saved the essay.

rows.name: Put your name on a carrel
rows.result: A small brass plate goes up. Strangers will revise under your name all year.

rows.name: Open the map drawers
rows.result: Your own suburb is in the drawer, the street still drawn in pencil.

rows.name: Drop a book in the chute
rows.result: The flap clacks, the book is gone, and closing time feels finished.

places.name: Barber and salon
places.feel: Clippers one side, dryers the other, every kind of hair welcome, and a wait that runs on weather and sport.

rows.name: Get a wash and a tidy
rows.result: A clean hairline and a cape-crease still on your shoulder when you hit the pavement.

rows.name: Get the small tidy
rows.result: Brows or a beard, a short sit, and your face looks like you slept.

rows.name: Book side-by-side chairs
rows.result: You and a friend spin at the same time and both claim you sat first.

rows.name: Wait with the magazines
rows.result: The pile is three years old. The commentary you add is brand new.

rows.name: Learn a simple plait or your edges
rows.result: The junior guides your hands once. The second try is one you can repeat in res.

rows.name: Take a plan and skip the cut
rows.result: They talk you through a shape. You book nothing until payday, and that is the lesson.

rows.name: Sweep and book
rows.result: The book stays straight, the tea gets passed, and the floor keeps ahead of the clippers.

rows.name: Book the visiting stylist
rows.result: The whole afternoon is yours, and you walk out looking like the poster in the window.

rows.name: Take the cape photo
rows.result: Before and after, only if you say yes, and the wall by the till gains a face.

rows.name: Take a hot towel while you wait
rows.result: A warm towel, a quiet minute, and the chair you are waiting for can take its time.

places.name: Lifecup cafe
places.feel: The Lifecup in town. Wood, the good milk, and laptops that have been open since Morning.

rows.name: Have a flat white in the corner
rows.result: The cup is hot, the corner is yours, and one reading actually finishes.

rows.name: Eat a muffin
rows.result: It is gone before the lid is back on the tin. No notes, no regrets.

rows.name: Join the big table upstairs
rows.result: Four people, one plug, and the essay moves in the gaps between the jokes.

rows.name: Have a slow coffee with someone
rows.result: You talk until the ice in theirs has vanished, and the time never comes up.

rows.name: Write a page in the noise
rows.result: The room turns into a beat and the page fills. The barista knows your face and lets it.

rows.name: Learn the grinder
rows.result: They let you pull one shot. It is ugly, and you understand the machine.

rows.name: Work the Lifecup rush
rows.result: The orders stack, you stop reading the cups and start hearing them, and the tip jar clinks.

rows.name: Close Lifecup
rows.result: Chairs up, the last flask is yours, and the sign flips while the street is still busy.

rows.name: Put the upstairs on your tab
rows.result: You tell the counter the room is on you, and the afternoon gets suddenly generous.

rows.name: Fill the loyalty card
rows.result: The tenth stamp lands, the next cup is on the house, and the pride is out of proportion.

places.name: Lounge
places.feel: Music, a pool table, board games, a karaoke corner, milkshakes and mocktails. Warm lights, and nobody is selling a night out you did not ask for.

rows.name: Drink a milkshake at the counter
rows.result: Thick, cold, and finished before the song changes.

rows.name: Order a mocktail
rows.result: Citrus, plenty of ice, and a glass that looks like you planned the evening.

rows.name: Play pool with your people
rows.result: The one straight cue goes to the guest, and you still take the last frame.

rows.name: Start a board game
rows.result: The rules argument outlasts the game, and everybody wants the rematch.

rows.name: Learn the karaoke folder
rows.result: You find three songs you can survive and write the titles on a napkin.

rows.name: Practise a speech in the booth
rows.result: The booth swallows the shake in your voice. The second run sounds like you.

rows.name: Host the lounge
rows.result: You seat people, teach one board game, and keep the song list from turning into a queue fight.

rows.name: Take the booth and the tower
rows.result: A tower of mocktails, the booth to yourselves, and the room notices the order.

rows.name: Put your name on the karaoke list
rows.result: You sing the chorus you know, sit down, and get applause you were not ready for.

rows.name: Play the last frame of the night
rows.result: The lights flick once for closing time, and the eight ball drops clean.

places.name: Gym
places.feel: The city gym, not the campus sports centre. Rubber floors, a fan that works, and someone always on one more rep.

rows.name: Buy a day pass and stretch
rows.result: You pay at the desk, stretch on the mat, and leave looser than you arrived.

rows.name: Buy a banana and a water
rows.result: The banana is honestly bruised and it does the job.

rows.name: Lift with a friend spotting
rows.result: They count the reps you were going to skip, and you return the favour.

rows.name: Take the treadmills side by side
rows.result: You talk in pieces, between the pace, and both of you stay on the belt.

rows.name: Learn the squat
rows.result: Five minutes of form and your knees stop arguing with the bar.

rows.name: Take a plan card
rows.result: Sets, days, and a rest you are told to keep. The card goes in your pocket.

rows.name: Work the gym desk
rows.result: Towels, the door buzzer, and by the second hour you know the regulars' names.

rows.name: Pay for eight sessions with the head trainer
rows.result: The block is paid up front. Today's session is the first, and the coach already has your name.

rows.name: Ride the window bike at sunset
rows.result: The street goes gold and you forget the timer is even on.

rows.name: Try the corner bell, carefully
rows.result: A staffer watches the first pull, nods, and the bell leaves the floor.

places.name: Church
places.feel: A brick church on the taxi route. Doors open, tea after, and nobody asks your surname.

rows.name: Sit in a back pew
rows.result: You sit where you can see the door, and the quiet does what the morning could not.

rows.name: Have tea and a biscuit
rows.result: The urn is free, the biscuit is plain, and someone remembers how you take it.

rows.name: Join the youth circle
rows.result: Board games on the hall floor after the singing, and your people take the round seriously.

rows.name: Dish at the community lunch
rows.result: You dish, then you sit, and the table makes room without a speech.

rows.name: Go to choir practice
rows.result: You do not have the harmony yet. On the last run you find the note.

rows.name: Read one quiet chapter
rows.result: You read until the page steadies, and you leave the marker in.

rows.name: Run the tea urn
rows.result: You pour, you stack the chairs, and the hall goes quiet behind you. The envelope has your name on it.

rows.name: Buy a speaker for the children's room
rows.result: They test it with a song the kids already know, and the room fills cleanly.

rows.name: Buy a bazaar plate
rows.result: Samoosas and a square of cake from the table outside, eaten in the sun.

rows.name: Stay for the sunset singing
rows.result: You can hum. The person beside you has the words, and that is enough.

places.name: Car dealership
places.feel: Bunting, a coffee flask, and a row of cars that have already lived a little. The first car is an old, honest little one; the used runabout is the later, bigger goal.

rows.name: Sit in a parked car
rows.result: Door open, hands on the wheel, and the salesperson lets you finish the thought.

rows.name: Take a cup from the flask
rows.result: It has been on the burner since Morning and it still counts as a welcome.

rows.name: Bring the honest friend
rows.result: They ask about the service book and save you from a shiny mistake.

rows.name: Write the one-day list
rows.result: On the back of a flyer, you and a friend design the car that waits for real money.

rows.name: Learn the checklist
rows.result: Tyres, papers, the smell of a tired gearbox. You can look properly after this.

rows.name: Watch a handover
rows.result: Keys, a signature, a photo by the bonnet. You see the order, so it will not spook you later.

rows.name: Work the showroom
rows.result: You dust bonnets and point at the board. One customer comes back just to say thanks.

rows.name: Buy the used runabout
rows.result: The key is yours. It has history, it starts, and the salesperson shakes your hand like you bought the row.

rows.name: Buy the first car
rows.result: An old, honest little car with one dent on the door, and it is all yours.

rows.name: Take a photo on a bonnet
rows.result: You pose on a car you are leaving behind, and your friend keeps the picture anyway.

places.name: Greenway supermarket
places.feel: The big Greenway in town, not the campus grocer. Wide aisles, a hot deli, and a till that takes Woza.

rows.name: Eat a deli plate
rows.result: Chicken, rice and a spoon of chakalaka, finished on the bench out front.

rows.name: Buy an apple
rows.result: You came for one thing, bought the apple, and escaped the specials.

rows.name: Do a house shop with friends
rows.result: The trolley becomes a debate and you still get out under the number you set.

rows.name: Pack for the person ahead
rows.result: You bag their tins while a friend reads you the rack headlines.

rows.name: Read two labels
rows.result: You pick the tin that is food and not mostly salt, and feel oddly powerful.

rows.name: Plan a res supper from the specials
rows.result: Pap, a sauce and a veg for R40. The pot at home will feed people.

rows.name: Work the Greenway till
rows.result: Beeps, bags, and a Woza tap that fails once. You sort it without a manager.

rows.name: Pack the shelves
rows.result: Tins in lines, bread to the front, and your shoulders file a complaint for tomorrow.

rows.name: Send a month of groceries to the house
rows.result: The Greenway van finds the res gate. The fridge goes from sad to serious in one trip.

rows.name: Catch the hot bread
rows.result: The tray comes out as you arrive, and the bag warms your hands all the way to the rank.

places.name: Beach
places.feel: Wind, a wide beach, vendors on the sand, and a lit promenade for after the swim.

rows.name: Buy a soft serve
rows.result: It drips once, you catch it, and the sea does the rest of the entertaining.

rows.name: Walk the waterline
rows.result: Shoes in one hand, a long line of footprints, and your head goes quiet.

rows.name: Play volleyball
rows.result: The net sags, your side still claims the ball was in, and the argument is the fun.

rows.name: Share fruit on a towel
rows.result: Naartjies get passed around and nobody hurries the afternoon.

rows.name: Swim to the near buoy
rows.result: You pick the close buoy, you make it, and the walk up the sand feels earned.

rows.name: Read the lifeguard board
rows.result: Flags, times, and where the pull is. You could explain it to the next person.

rows.name: Push the ice-cream cart
rows.result: The soft serve leans in the heat, and children appear the second you stop the cart.

rows.name: Book a cabana for your people
rows.result: Shade, a fruit platter, and a stretch of morning that belongs to your table.

rows.name: Walk the lit promenade
rows.result: You stay under the lights, the sea stays a sound, and you keep your feet on the path.

rows.name: Keep one empty shell
rows.result: One small shell, nobody home, and it earns a spot on the res shelf.

places.name: Park
places.feel: A path, a lawn, and ducks who have already met every kind of student.

rows.name: Sit with a cooldrink
rows.result: You sit long enough for a stranger's dog to approve of you.

rows.name: Walk one loop
rows.result: The loop is short and your shoulders drop somewhere on the far side.

rows.name: Picnic on the lawn
rows.result: The blanket is too small, the food is enough, and that is the right way round.

rows.name: Play a loose game
rows.result: Jackets for goalposts, no referee, and a score nobody will agree.

rows.name: Jog the path
rows.result: One loop, no performance, which was the whole idea.

rows.name: Make a list for a course
rows.result: Three trees and a bird you can name in the practical, written down before they fade.

rows.name: Do a depot hour
rows.result: Bins, the water table, a bright vest. The park looks better when you clock out.

rows.name: Hire the lawn and a photographer
rows.result: The lawn is booked under your name. The photos come back looking like the house has a magazine.

rows.name: Stay when the sprinklers start
rows.result: They come on without a warning and your people stay in, shoes and all.

rows.name: Feed the ducks from the gate tin
rows.result: You use the seed the sign asks for, and the child at the tin copies you.

places.name: Arcade and bowling
places.feel: Neon, rented shoes, and cabinets that want coins. A win is a cheer or a printed photo, never cash.

rows.name: Play one racing cabinet
rows.result: You finish last and still get the cheer for missing most of the walls.

rows.name: Play the dance mat alone
rows.result: The arrows are faster than your pride, and you finish the song anyway.

rows.name: Take a lane with your people
rows.result: Historic shoes, a gutter that knows you, and a terrible photo you will keep.

rows.name: Play air hockey
rows.result: One puck, a lot of noise, and a winner who demands a rematch they might lose.

rows.name: Learn the bowling approach
rows.result: Four steps and a straight arm. The next frame stays out of the gutter.

rows.name: Chase a score for the wall
rows.result: The cabinet prints a photo, not a payout, and they pin it up if you ask.

rows.name: Work the arcade floor
rows.result: You spray shoes, reset a lane, and talk a player through the bumpers.

rows.name: Buy a private bowling night
rows.result: The lights go silly, the lane is yours, and the playlist is whatever you can agree.

rows.name: Hit the strike light
rows.result: All ten fall, the lane flashes, and the desk pretends they see it every hour.

rows.name: Drink a milkshake in bowling shoes
rows.result: You forget to change the shoes. Nobody stops you. The shake is cold and the carpet survives.

places.name: Taxi rank
places.feel: Callers, a board of routes, and minibuses that leave when the seats say so. Busy from early Morning.

rows.name: Take a local trip
rows.result: You pass the fare forward, the door slams, and your stop arrives before the back-seat story ends.

rows.name: Buy a vetkoek
rows.result: Hot in the serviette, gone by the time the marshal points you to a van.

rows.name: Share the long seat
rows.result: Four of you, one story, and the aunty by the window supplies a better ending.

rows.name: Read the board with a friend
rows.result: You solve the route together and only nearly miss the right van.

rows.name: Learn three hand signs
rows.result: A caller shows you. You try one, and the right taxi actually slows.

rows.name: Time the gap
rows.result: You watch the clock until you know the wait, and tomorrow you can leave res later.

rows.name: Call the routes
rows.result: You call a destination clearly, people find the van, and the marshal bumps your shoulder.

rows.name: Charter a big taxi for the house
rows.result: Door to door, the long way, your whole people in one van that is not hunting a rank.

rows.name: Ride in the front seat
rows.result: The front seat, a radio compromise, and the driver asks your stop like a host.

rows.name: Read the window slogans
rows.result: You work along the backs of the vans until one line makes the whole rank kinder.

places.name: Petrol station
places.feel: A corner station that barely closes. Pies under a lamp, a wash bay, and an air line anybody can use.

rows.name: Eat a pie and a cooldrink
rows.result: Hot in the middle, cold in the can, and the forecourt is the dining room.

rows.name: Charge your phone in the shop
rows.result: You stand by the fridge, the battery climbs, and nobody moves you on.

rows.name: Share chips on the low wall
rows.result: Legs dangling, one packet, and a live review of every car that misses the entrance.

rows.name: Narrate the wash bay
rows.result: You give the rollers a sports call, and the driver inside the bay starts laughing.

rows.name: Learn the board by the oil
rows.result: Dipstick, water, the warning lights. The attendant points, and next time you could do it.

rows.name: Wash your own car twice
rows.result: The first pass streaks. The second sheets off clean, and you can see your grin in the door.

rows.name: Work the pumps
rows.result: You ask the amount, you never round anyone up, and the shift lead notices.

rows.name: Join the wash crew
rows.result: Foam, a mitt, and a bakkie that leaves shinier than it arrived.

rows.name: Buy the fancy tank and the deluxe wash
rows.result: The good fuel, a wash that includes the mats, and an air freshener with ambitions.

rows.name: Stay in for the roller wash
rows.result: Foam eats the glass, the world goes white, and you roll out gleaming and a bit thrilled.

places.name: Stadium
places.feel: Concrete, a pitch you can smell, and stands that turn a practice into an occasion.

rows.name: Eat a boerie roll
rows.result: Onions, sauce, a serviette that gives up immediately. You eat it facing the pitch.

rows.name: Watch training from up high
rows.result: The players are small from here and the drills are still easy to read.

rows.name: Stand in the student block
rows.result: You stand, you sit, you shout the same word, and the block starts to feel like yours.

rows.name: Learn the clap from the row in front
rows.result: They teach you the pattern. By the second time you are no longer late.

rows.name: Walk the outside track
rows.result: One lap under the stand, steady, while practice carries on without you.

rows.name: Ask how the gates work
rows.result: Entrances, the overflow, where to send a lost parent. You file it.

rows.name: Steward the stands
rows.result: You point, you scan, and when the place fills you are the calm one on the step.

rows.name: Buy a season seat on the halfway line
rows.result: Your name is on a seat for the term. The first sit feels like a small ceremony.

rows.name: Catch the tunnel glimpse
rows.result: Boots on concrete, close enough to hear, and the tunnel hums as they come through.

rows.name: Stay for the empty pitch
rows.result: The stands thin. The ground staff start their work, and the evening lands softly.

places.name: Driving school
places.feel: Cones, a dual-control car, and an instructor who has already met every kind of nerves. The licence comes from here.

rows.name: Read the learner's book
rows.result: You page it while you wait, and one rule you always mix up finally stays.

rows.name: Buy a cooldrink from the office fridge
rows.result: A cold can, a plastic chair, and your name called before the tin is empty.

rows.name: Ride along on a friend's yard lesson
rows.result: You hold the diagram and cheer the one cone they leave standing.

rows.name: Do the learners' quiz
rows.result: You miss the give-way question, argue it, and then you stop missing it.

rows.name: Take the yard lesson
rows.result: Clutch, cones, a stall you recover. The instructor says "again" the way a coach says it.

rows.name: Take the road lesson
rows.result: A real lane, a real robot, and your hands remember where to rest.

rows.name: Wash the school cars
rows.result: Dual-control cars, a festival of bugs on the nose, and a windscreen the instructor calls honest.

rows.name: Book the defensive day
rows.result: A full day on space and skids with the senior instructor. You leave calmer than the commute.

rows.name: Take the licence test
rows.needs: Yard lesson and road lesson done
rows.result: The card is yours. Your hands wait until afterwards to shake.

rows.name: Practise the hill start
rows.result: The car holds, rolls a thumb's width, then goes. You grin at an empty street.

places.name: Recording studio
places.feel: Foam, a couch that has heard everything, and a red light over the door.

rows.name: Sit on the couch and listen back
rows.result: They play a take from earlier. You hear the room, not just the voice.

rows.name: Make tea from the studio kettle
rows.result: A chipped mug, rooibos, and the red light off, which is when people actually talk.

rows.name: Buy a short booth slot for harmonies
rows.result: The second voice fixes the line you could not land on your own.

rows.name: Write a chorus on the couch
rows.result: Two lines and a clap. Your friend keeps the better line and still gives you the credit.

rows.name: Learn the pop filter and the levels
rows.result: One knob at a time. Your voice stops booming and starts sounding like you.

rows.name: Record a spoken take for a course
rows.result: A clean reading. The lecturer will hear the words, not the res corridor.

rows.name: Run the studio
rows.result: Cables, water, the door, the times. The session runs long and the take survives.

rows.name: Book a night lock-in with a player
rows.result: The room is yours until morning, a session player sits in, and you leave with a song that exists.

rows.name: Record your first take
rows.result: The red light goes on, the street disappears, and you get through the whole thing once.

rows.name: Hold the lyric page for someone
rows.result: You mind the words while they sing. The thank-you in the hallway names the exact line.

places.name: Campus radio station
places.feel: The campus station's studio in town, so the trip is a city trip. Mugs, faders, and an on-air light that still makes people sit up.

rows.name: Sit in on a show
rows.result: Headphones on a hook, and a presenter talks like the whole city is in the room.

rows.name: Wash a mug and stay for a song
rows.result: The sink is how you join. Someone shows you the kettle's particular trick.

rows.name: Read a traffic line with a friend
rows.result: You split three lines. Your friend cracks up at the mall robot, and it still goes out.

rows.name: Keep quiet on the couch for a live hour
rows.result: The light is on, so your people discover they can be silent. Afterwards they make up for it.

rows.name: Learn the faders
rows.result: Bed, voice, the station jingle. You fade one join and it does not clip.

rows.name: Write a two-minute campus note
rows.result: You keep it short. The producer cuts one joke and keeps the useful bit.

rows.name: Operate the board
rows.result: A real hour, sweaty hands, and the show still ends when it is supposed to.

rows.name: Put your name on a week of stings
rows.result: Between songs the city hears your name, and the res kitchen messages you at once.

rows.name: Watch the breakfast handover
rows.result: Two presenters swap chairs, the light never drops, and you see how a morning is built.

rows.name: Play a late request the station owns
rows.result: The ask fits the shelf. You cue it, and the text that comes back is in capitals.

places.name: Aquarium
places.feel: Blue dark, a tunnel, and school groups who know more about sharks than you do.

rows.name: Walk the tunnel slowly
rows.result: Student rate. A ray goes over you like a quiet aircraft and you stop mid-step.

rows.name: Touch the outside rockpool
rows.result: The outside pool is free. A crab ignores you, and the board says that is a good sign.

rows.name: Stand with a friend at the jellyfish
rows.result: You both go quiet at the same tank and stay past the sensible minute.

rows.name: Do the quiz card with your people
rows.result: The card was printed for children. You still argue about the octopus, and then you know it.

rows.name: Follow one talk the whole way
rows.result: The door talk is free. You stay for the loop, and a test later in the term gets easier.

rows.name: Sketch one fish for a practical
rows.result: You draw what is in front of you, not the version in your head, and the labels get easier.

rows.name: Guide a school group
rows.result: The script sticks by the second tank, and a learner kindly corrects you on the sharks.

rows.name: Book the tunnel after hours for six
rows.result: After closing, six of you, and a keeper who answers what the sign will not.

rows.name: Watch the feeding from the rail
rows.result: A rush of silver, then calm. You forget to lift your phone, which is how you know you watched.

rows.name: Pick a ray and learn its notch
rows.result: One notch on a wing, and next visit you look for that ray the way regulars do.

places.name: Night market
places.feel: Food trucks, string lights, and queues that are the review. It wakes up as the day tips toward evening.

rows.name: Buy one plate from one truck
rows.result: A bunny from the blue truck, eaten standing, sauce on one knuckle.

rows.name: Buy a juice while you decide
rows.result: One lap of the row with a cup, and the choice gets easier.

rows.name: Split three small plates
rows.result: Three trucks, one verdict, and almost nobody disputes the winner.

rows.name: Hold a table for the group
rows.result: You guard the benches, they arrive with food, and the system works.

rows.name: Watch the pan and remember the order
rows.result: Onions first, then the rest. A smaller version is possible in the res kitchen.

rows.name: Price a supper for four before you order
rows.result: The sums fit on your phone. You come in under the number, and the table notices.

rows.name: Help on a truck
rows.result: Boxes and plates. The staff plate they hand you does not appear on the board.

rows.name: Run a juice table
rows.result: A borrowed table, a jug, and a queue of campus faces. The float balances at the end.

rows.name: Buy a plate from every truck
rows.result: The table disappears under boxes. You meant to show off and ended up hosting.

rows.name: Stay for the last song under the lights
rows.result: A speaker on a tailgate, trucks closing, and your people in no rush for a taxi.

places.name: Swimming pool
places.feel: Chlorine, lane ropes, and a kiosk toasted sandwich. Municipal, honest, busiest in the Morning.

rows.name: Swim in a public lane
rows.result: A slow breaststroke, and you climb out with your head rinsed clean.

rows.name: Eat a toasted sandwich
rows.result: The cheese pulls. You eat it on the bench, chlorine still in the towel.

rows.name: Share a lane with a friend
rows.result: One length you both refuse to call a race, and you tie on purpose.

rows.name: Talk in the shallow end
rows.result: Elbows on the side, feet off the floor, and a conversation that needed water around it.

rows.name: Learn a tumble turn
rows.result: You swallow once, then you stop swallowing, and the turn starts to look like a turn.

rows.name: Count ten lengths for a log
rows.result: Ten lengths, written down, no audience. The log was the point.

rows.name: Marshal the lanes
rows.result: The fast lane stays fast. On your watch, nobody meets in the middle.

rows.name: Hire the pool after hours
rows.result: The house has the water. The lights stay on and the city stays outside.

rows.name: Jump the high board once
rows.result: You look, you go, the smack is loud, and the lifeguard gives you a thumb.

rows.name: Float until the whistle
rows.result: The ceiling is a grid. You float until the whistle, and the day unclenches.

places.name: Skate park
places.feel: Bowls, a rail, and boards repaired more often than replaced. A speaker nobody quite owns.

rows.name: Sit on the edge and watch a line
rows.result: You learn the rhythm of the bowl before you ever stand on a board.

rows.name: Hire a board for one slow loop
rows.result: Pads included. You complete the loop and feel about twelve feet tall.

rows.name: Use a friend's board and their patience
rows.result: They hold on for the first push and let go at the exact right second.

rows.name: Take turns while the speaker plays
rows.result: Falls get funnier, turns get braver, and the worst one stays off camera.

rows.name: Take a lesson from the local
rows.result: Foot here, eyes there. You roll away in a line that does not wobble.

rows.name: Tighten your own trucks
rows.result: A borrowed tool, a feel for what tight does, and the board stops wandering.

rows.name: Work the rentals desk
rows.result: Pads, boards, names on a list. Every helmet comes back, which is the job.

rows.name: Order a board shaped for you
rows.result: The shaper asks how you ride, not who you are copying. The board fits your feet.

rows.name: Skate under the floodlight
rows.result: The light hums, the concrete still holds the day's heat, and the line looks cleaner than it feels.

rows.name: Land the drop-in you do not rewind
rows.result: You drop, you stay up, and the bowl makes a small sound that might be respect.

places.name: Phone and tech shop
places.feel: Glass counters, a patient person with a screwdriver, and a case for every colour. The till takes Woza.

rows.name: Buy a clear case and a cloth
rows.result: The cheapest protection in the shop, fitted while you wait, and the phone looks minded.

rows.name: Charge from the bar while you browse
rows.result: The bar is free. You leave with a full battery and the same money you walked in with.

rows.name: Compare two phones with a friend
rows.result: They stop you buying the shiny one. You thank them on the taxi home.

rows.name: Take a group photo on the demo model
rows.result: The camera is better than yours. The photo is silly, and you send it before you reach the door.

rows.name: Watch a screen repair
rows.result: Suction, a pick, a ribbon. The quote suddenly has reasons.

rows.name: Fix your mail so it stops eating data
rows.result: Three switches go off. The bundle lasts longer by the weekend.

rows.name: Work the phone-shop floor
rows.result: You match cases to phones and explain a warranty without inventing a single word.

rows.name: Buy the new flagship for cash
rows.result: You Woza the last cent. The box is heavy, and you carry it through the car park like a trophy.

rows.name: Back everything up, properly
rows.result: They sit with you until the bar finishes. Your photos stop living on a hope.

rows.name: Buy the student brick
rows.result: A tough little phone that survives a drop. It will get you through exams, and it looks like it.

places.name: Fashion boutique
places.feel: One room and one rail that matters. The person here would rather you leave with nothing than with the wrong thing. This is not the mall.

rows.name: Look, and ask before you touch
rows.result: A slow lap. They clock your size and stay quiet until you ask.

rows.name: Buy the perfect plain socks
rows.result: You came to stare and leave with socks. They become the best pair you own.

rows.name: Use a friend as the mirror
rows.result: One jacket. Your friend says no before you fall for it, and they are right.

rows.name: Add one thing to clothes you already own
rows.result: The new piece is small. Your friend sees how it wakes the old ones.

rows.name: Learn what fits your shoulders
rows.result: A shoulder seam, explained on your own jacket. Shopping gets cheaper after this.

rows.name: Get a hem while you wait
rows.result: Pins, a machine, and a length that finally meets your shoes.

rows.name: Work the boutique floor
rows.result: You steam, you size, you never push. A customer comes back and asks for you.

rows.name: Buy the window look, fitted
rows.result: The outfit from the glass, taken in to you. You stand still and the street looks back.

rows.name: Use the repair basket
rows.result: A button and a stitch, and a shirt you had retired goes back into the week.

rows.name: Leave with a sketch
rows.result: They draw the thing you described and tell you to save toward it. The sketch goes in a book.

places.name: Hiking trail
places.feel: A gate, a marked path, and a view that earns the taxi fare. Daylight only, and the path stays on the path.

rows.name: Walk the short loop to the first bench
rows.result: You reach the bench, drink water, and turn around proud of a small true thing.

rows.name: Buy a fruit at the gate stall
rows.result: An apple, and a "go well" from the person who counts heads without a fuss.

rows.name: Walk the loop with your people
rows.result: A line, then a bunch, and the view lands harder because someone gasps.

rows.name: Eat a packed lunch on the flat rock
rows.result: Sandwiches you made, shared out, and the ants get almost nothing.

rows.name: Read the trail board and follow it
rows.result: Markers, the turn to skip, the time it really takes. You stop guessing.

rows.name: Hold a pace you can keep
rows.result: No racing. You arrive with enough left to look at the view, not your shoes.

rows.name: Join the trail crew
rows.result: You clear a drain and repaint an arrow. The next walker will not have to guess.

rows.name: Book a guided morning and a hired pack
rows.result: A guide, a decent pack, dawn to lunch. You see the ridge and you are back for Social.

rows.name: Sign the summit book
rows.result: The tin, the book, and handwriting that looks happy.

rows.name: Take the waterfall turn-off
rows.result: A short side path, cold air off the water, and you stand in the spray with both feet on rock.

places.name: Art gallery
places.feel: White rooms, a bench, and a wall of student work with the prices in pencil.

rows.name: Give one room your full attention
rows.result: Entry is free. One painting gets the time you usually give a whole building.

rows.name: Sit on the middle bench
rows.result: You sit until the picture changes, which is just you slowing down.

rows.name: Disagree with a friend, politely
rows.result: You like different pictures. You both have reasons. You leave as kinder arguers.

rows.name: Fill in the comment cards together
rows.result: Two honest lines. The person on the door reads them and smiles without performing it.

rows.name: Sketch from the painting, not a photo
rows.result: The page is worse than the wall and better than last time. That is the practice.

rows.name: Ask how a show gets hung
rows.result: Height, light, the order of the story. You walk back through and you can see it.

rows.name: Sit the gallery
rows.result: You watch the room and answer one question. A painting is safer because you were there.

rows.name: Buy a small canvas from the student wall
rows.result: A pencil price, your name in the book, and a painting that makes the res room look decided.

rows.name: See the store room if they offer
rows.result: Crates, labels, the work that is not up yet. You are briefly behind the curtain.

rows.name: Buy a postcard of the one you cannot take home
rows.result: The postcard, not the painting. You pin it where you will see it before a test.

places.name: Community hall
places.feel: Plastic chairs, a curtain that almost closes, and a kitchen hatch. The neighbourhood borrows the room.

rows.name: Sit in on a free talk
rows.result: Somebody explains a thing the suburb needs. You leave with a number written properly.

rows.name: Buy tea from the hatch
rows.result: A paper cup, sugar if you want it, and a hello from the person on the urn.

rows.name: Set a friend's table their way
rows.result: The chairs go where they asked. The event starts on time, which they will remember.

rows.name: Play the hall's board-game afternoon
rows.result: Games out of a cupboard, your table getting loud in a friendly way.

rows.name: Learn the microphone
rows.result: On, off, and you do not tap it. One sentence, and the room hears you.

rows.name: Practise a talk on the empty stage
rows.result: The curtain sticks. You finish anyway, and the empty chairs are a kinder crowd than you feared.

rows.name: Set up the hall
rows.result: Rows of chairs, a swept stage, tape on the cable. The hirer walks in and exhales.

rows.name: Book the hall for your event
rows.result: Your name in the diary, chairs included, and a date your people can plan around.

rows.name: Stand in the wings for the choir
rows.result: A neighbourhood choir starts, and the gap in the curtain is the whole magic.

rows.name: Work one service at the hatch
rows.result: Plates out, plates back. You join the rhythm for one service and leave with flour on a sleeve.

places.name: Laundromat
places.feel: Warm tumblers, a television with the sound down, and plastic chairs that know the suburb.

rows.name: Run one load and mind it
rows.result: The machine hops, you watch it, and the clothes come out smelling like a reset.

rows.name: Fold what you already washed
rows.result: The pile becomes a stack you can carry in one arm.

rows.name: Split two baskets with a friend
rows.result: Two machines, shared change, and a conversation that lasts exactly one spin cycle.

rows.name: Take the television chairs
rows.result: Sound down, subtitles on, and the commentary supplied by your people.

rows.name: Learn the stain chart
rows.result: Oil, ink, the red sauce. You stop guessing and ruining a shirt.

rows.name: Sort a wash so the colours survive
rows.result: Darks, lights, and the one red item held back. The chart was right.

rows.name: Fold for the laundromat
rows.result: Other people's warm towels, folded square. The pay feels fair for the heat.

rows.name: Buy the year plan
rows.result: They wash and fold your basket every week for the year. You drop it off and go live.

rows.name: Watch one sock go around
rows.result: One sock, one drum, and your pulse matches it. You needed exactly that.

rows.name: Rescue a res laundry mountain
rows.result: A house's worth, paid and bagged. You return to the passage as the hero of the floor.
